summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new authenticated PORTAL and routing separation on the preview URL. Verified: self-registration -> auto redirect to /portal; visiting / while logged in bounces to /portal; portal shell (sidebar/topbar/user email/logout/view-site); real LLM scan of https://linear.app (completed ~60s, 90 queries); Opportunities screen (count, top-5 cards, missed-searches 4,900 = sum of top5, 90-row table with volume + 'Not visible yet'); generate-pages via real LLM (6 published page cards with reach + keyword chips + live links); public /p?slug=... landing page (title, 3 services, 4 FAQ accordion expand) with lead form submit -> success state; lead appears in /portal/leads with correct name/email/company, leads-stat-total=1, search filter, status change + notes save (toast 'Lead updated', persisted after reload), CSV export download; logged-out auth guard on /portal, /portal/opportunities, /portal/leads all redirect to /; logout returns to marketing. Pricing CTA responsiveness at 390x844 on /fractional-cxo verified with no overflow/clipping. All primary flows PASS; two portal UX gaps found.

ui_bugs.issue: For a newly registered user the legacy 'Let's scan your business / Run my growth 360' onboarding modal (onboarding-overlay, z-[100]) opens ON TOP of the portal Discover screen, fully blocking scan-url-input/scan-start-button until 'Skip for now' is clicked. It is a second, competing scan flow and contradicts the new portal-first UX. Suggest not rendering Onboarding inside /portal routes (or replacing the portal scan with it).

No way to log out or 'View site' on mobile/tablet (<768px): portal-logout and portal-view-site live only inside the md:flex sidebar; the mobile topbar avatar is not a menu. Mobile users are stuck in the portal.
Filter row cramped: the 'Show spam' checkbox label is pushed flush to the right edge and the Export button wraps to its own line (no viewport overflow, cosmetic).

issues: Floating chat widget sits over the bottom-left sidebar area and, on mobile /portal, near the 'Start AI analysis' button; clicks still register (elementFromPoint at portal-logout returns portal-logout) but it visually overlaps the 'Log out' label.

action_items: Do not render the legacy Onboarding growth-360 modal on /portal routes (it blocks the portal scan form for every new user).
Expose Log out / View site in the portal mobile topbar (or a mobile menu) since the sidebar is hidden below md.
Optional: tighten the leads filter row layout at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalScan/Opportunities/GeneratedPages/PortalLeadsBoard build API base from window.location.origin instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — works today because frontend and API share the origin, but it deviates from the env-var rule and will break if the API host differs.
Fetch error handling swallows the real error (catch {} + generic toast) with no HTTP status surfaced; a failed 120s LLM scan gives the user no diagnostic. Consider surfacing status/detail.
GeneratedPages 'Regenerate' has no confirmation — one click replaces all published pages (and orphans their public URLs).

context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthModal mode toggles are data-testid auth-mode-login / auth-mode-signup (NOT 'register'). Landing page uses heavy animation so page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') times out — use domcontentloaded + explicit selector waits. LLM scan took ~60s and page generation ~90s; use 150s waits. A global Onboarding overlay must be skipped ([data-testid=onboarding-skip]) right after login before interacting with /portal. Portal mobile tab links now have data-testid portal-nav-<x>-mobile (added by this agent). Coupons/admin (iteration_1) and Razorpay payment were not touched.
rca_of_the_issue: Onboarding is mounted globally in app/providers.jsx, so it renders on every route including the new /portal shell; its z-[100] fixed overlay covers the portal Discover screen for users who have not completed/skipped onboarding.
